_comment: Stage 3 skeleton for Gone Girl (2014) recap. Units are in source-film chronological order from U02 onward; only U01 (hook) has narrative_jump=true. must_cover references catalogued beats from shots.json (1-36). TWIST DISCIPLINE: U01-U08 (beats 1-15) frame Amy as a missing/grieving victim with ZERO leak; U09 (beat 16) is the explicit reveal; U10-U18 (beats 16-36) frame Amy as the orchestrator. Cool Girl (U10) is faithful paraphrase, no quoted excerpts. Desi murder (U15) is described without lurid detail; S7 censor applies at render. Pregnancy thread: claimed in U07 (B13) -> used as leverage in U17 (B35). Tiers: tier is the schema enum (LIGHT/STANDARD/DEEP); tier_label adds CRITICAL for hook + turning points. target_total sized for ~7 min default-rate Andrew TTS (~1600 words, Prisoners scope). [REGISTER B UPDATE 2026-06-16: target_words re-planned to the Light Register B draft distribution per docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md; interpretive layer adds weight to U02/U04/U06/U10/U13/U14/U17; twist U09 and bookend U18 kept lean per G4 restraint. tolerance 0.3 retained.] [MEDIUM REGISTER B 2026-06-16: target_words re-planned to Medium B distribution per STYLE_GUIDE sec5; +interpretive lines per major character, theme statements, retention prompts; stronger viral hook cold-open on B4/B5.]

units.label: Hook - the perfect marriage, the missing wife
units.why: Atmospheric setup + Serabudabu intro + film title teaser. Frames Amy as missing, NO twist leak.

units.label: Anniversary morning - Nick and Amy
units.why: Establish the marriage, the meet-cute charm; Amy still alive in flashback.

units.label: She is gone
units.why: The disappearance + staged-looking scene. Turning point that opens the mystery.

units.label: Amazing Amy and a marriage built on a story
units.why: Amazing Amy backstory + first police doubts about how little Nick knows.

units.label: Suspects and clues
units.why: Desi the obsessive ex introduced; treasure-hunt clues as a thread.

units.label: A marriage curdles
units.why: Flashback: money + resentment erode the marriage; the town searches. Victim framing.

units.label: The vigil and the pregnancy
units.why: Vigil; the claimed pregnancy revealed (B13) - START of the pregnancy thread. Amy = grieving victim.

units.label: The case turns on Nick
units.why: Staged scene, debt, insurance, the secret affair = motive. Suspicion peaks on Nick.

units.label: She was never gone
units.why: THE TWIST. Amy alive, driving away. Explicit reveal beat - the narration turns here.

units.label: How to vanish - the plan revealed
units.why: Staging recipe (S6) + Cool Girl monologue as FAITHFUL PARAPHRASE. Amy = architect. Heaviest unit.

units.label: On the run
units.why: Amy hides at the motel; Nick hires Tanner. Two threads in parallel.

units.label: The plan unravels
units.why: Media brands Nick a killer; the motel robbery (S6) strips Amy's escape money.

units.label: Into the gilded cage
units.why: Broke, Amy turns to Desi; his lake house becomes a new kind of trap.

units.label: Performance and pressure
units.why: Nick's calculated TV remorse (B25) vs police closing in (B26). Both perform.

units.label: The final move
units.why: Amy decides to return and removes Desi (S7 censor). Murder described without lurid detail.

units.label: The bloody homecoming
units.why: Amy's blood-soaked return + the fabricated kidnapping story to police.

units.label: The truth between them
units.why: Boney's doubt vs the airtight story; Amy admits the murder; the pregnancy leverage USED (B35) - thread payoff.

units.label: Trapped
units.why: The couple reunited for the cameras; the bookend close. What have we done to each other.

units.label: Closing thoughts
units.why: Thematic closure (marriage as performance/mutual capture) + thanks + subscribe.
